verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of in-product SQL authoring is a single line listing built-in LLM functions for SQL generation. The remote MCP server serves external agents, and Dives build dashboards rather than act as a SQL assistant, so neither counts as a built-in SQL assistant. missing for 10: documented AI fixing of broken SQL, AI explanation of queries, evidence of schema-aware natural-language generation inside the editor/UI, hands-on or independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant writes, fixes, and explains SQL against my schemas from natural language, inside the product

citations.quote: AI Functions: Built-in LLM functions for text analysis, embeddings, and SQL generation
